item.title: Strait of Hormuz: Trump’s ultimatum to Iran
item.summary: Donald #Trump issued an ultimatum to #Iran on March 22: 48 hours to reopen the Strait of #Hormuz or the #US will strike Iranian oil facilities. Tehran has responded, warning it would retaliate.

item.title: France’s municipal elections : Emmanuel Grégoire elected Paris mayor
item.summary: “Paris is not, and will never be, a far-right city,” insisted socialist Emmanuel Grégoire on Sunday March 22, newly elected Mayor of Paris, according to early results.#EmmanuelGrégoire #ParisMayor

item.title: Emmanuel Grégoire elected Paris mayor, succeeding fellow left-winger Anne Hidalgo
item.summary: Socialist frontrunner Emmanuel Grégoire comfortably defeated veteran conservative Rachida Dati in a second-round runoff for Paris mayor, exit polls showed Sunday, in the last major test of the French public mood ahead of next year’s all-important presidential election.

item.title: Socialist incumbent defeats far-right challenger in key Marseille mayoral election
item.summary: Left-wing incumbent Benoît Payan was comfortably re-elected mayor of France's second city Marseille on Sunday, holding off a challenge from far-right candidate Franck Allisio, projections from several pollsters showed.
